value.rationale: Complete nonasymptotic optimal two-site placement for the canonical rough exponential/Matérn-half kernel with independent equal-variance observation noise, including all boundary and collision designs. At the natural noise-to-signal ratio one the optimal sites are universal trisection independently of covariance length, with explicit weights/error; otherwise the location crosses the same sharp threshold and follows a monotone implementable equation. This exact design law is not a mere table entry, cosmetic reparametrization or generic conditional-variance identity.
